title: Octave keys
description: A one-octave instrument pairs independently raised key faces with opt-in synthesized notes.
useCase: Playable instrument previews and audio interfaces with immediate press feedback.
interaction: Enable sound, then press a key
reducedMotion: Key travel settles instantly. Sound stays explicitly opt-in.
limitations: Web Audio triangle oscillators, not sampled piano audio. Browser audio activation requires a user gesture.
look: Off-white skeuomorphic keyboard case with an inset keybed of glossy white keys and dark olive sharps, small grey note letters and a toggle button.
motion: Pressing a key drops its face 3 px over 110 ms ease-out and fades in an inner shadow; with sound on, each held key plays a triangle-wave note.
adapt: Key travel is CSS: `.sf-octave-key-face` transitions `transform 110ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` to `translateY(3px)` when `data-pressed` is true. Audio lives in `start` and `stop` (triangle oscillator, 15 ms attack, `setTargetAtTime` release); swap `keys` or the waveform for your instrument.
